units.source_text: 随后派人去召请阿阇梨到山庄来，托他举办大女公子周年忌辰的佛事。

en.t: Afterward, he sent someone to summon the ajari to the mountain villa and asked him to conduct Buddhist rites for the first anniversary of the elder young lady's death.

units.source_text: 又对他说：“我想，我常常到这里来，回想不可挽回之事而伤心，亦属徒劳无益。

en.t: He also said to him, "I think it is useless for me to keep coming here, grieving as I remember what can never be undone.

units.source_text: 因此想把这山庄拆毁，在你那山寺旁边建造一所佛殿。

en.t: So I would like to tear down this mountain villa and build a Buddha hall beside your mountain temple.

units.source_text: 反正一定要造，不如早日动工。”

en.t: Since it must be built in any case, it would be better to begin the work soon."

units.source_text: 就把几间佛堂、若干回廊及僧房，以及其他应有房室都画出来，同阿阇梨商谈。

en.t: He then drew plans for several Buddha halls, a number of corridors and monks' quarters, as well as the other necessary rooms, and discussed them with the ajari.

units.source_text: 阿阇梨大为赞善，说这是功德无量。

en.t: The ajari warmly approved, saying that this would bring immeasurable merit.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言又说：“不过这是八亲王当年用心设计建造的住宅，我把它拆毁，似乎太无情义。

en.t: Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, went on, "Still, this is the residence that Prince Hachi once designed and built with great care, so it seems rather heartless for me to tear it down.

units.source_text: 但我推想他的本意，原是想在佛事上面做功德的，只因顾念身后还有两位女公子，所以不曾建造寺院。

en.t: But as I consider his true intention, I think he originally wished to gain merit through Buddhist works, and only refrained from building a temple because he was concerned for the two young ladies he would leave behind.

units.source_text: 惟现在这是匂亲王夫人的产业，应归匂亲王所有。

en.t: Now, however, this is the property of Prince Niou's wife and should belong to Prince Niou.

units.source_text: 如此说来，未便把它改作寺院。

en.t: Seen in that light, it would not be proper to turn it into a temple.

units.source_text: 我也不该任意处置。

en.t: Nor should I dispose of it as I please.

units.source_text: 然而这地方太近河岸，过分显露，还不如把它拆毁，改造佛寺，另行建造庄屋。”

en.t: Yet this place is too close to the riverbank and much too exposed, so it would be better to tear it down, turn it into a Buddhist temple, and build another estate house elsewhere."

units.source_text: 阿阇梨说：“此事无论从哪一方面看来，都是莫大功德。

en.t: The ajari said, "No matter how one looks at this matter, it is an act of great merit.

units.source_text: 从前曾有一人，悲伤儿子死亡，把尸体包好了挂在颈上，挂了许多年。

en.t: Long ago, there was a man who grieved over his son's death, wrapped up the body, and wore it around his neck for many years.

units.source_text: 后来受了佛法感化，把尸囊舍弃，终于进入佛道。

en.t: Later, moved by the Buddha's teaching, he cast away the bundle containing the body and finally entered the Buddhist path.

units.source_text: 如今大人看到这山庄，便触景生情，实甚不利于修行。

en.t: Now, when you see this mountain villa, the scene stirs your feelings, which is truly harmful to spiritual practice.

units.source_text: 若能改作寺院，则对后世有劝修之功德，理应早日动工。

en.t: If it can be made into a temple, it will have the merit of encouraging later generations to practice, so work should begin soon.

units.source_text: 即请宣召阴阳博士，选定吉日。

en.t: Please summon the Doctor of Yin and Yang at once and have him choose an auspicious day.

units.source_text: 并雇用技术高明之工匠二三人，计划工事。

en.t: Also hire two or three highly skilled craftsmen and have them plan the construction.

units.source_text: 其他细节，按照佛教宗门定规布置可也。”

en.t: As for the other details, they may be arranged according to the established rules of the Buddhist order."

units.source_text: 薰中纳言便就各项事宜规定办法。

en.t: Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, then set procedures for each of the matters involved.

units.source_text: 又召集附近领地内庄屋中人员，吩咐他们：“此次建造寺院，一切工事均须遵照阿阇梨指示。”

en.t: He also gathered the people from the estate houses on nearby lands and instructed them, "All work on this temple construction must follow the ajari's directions."

units.source_text: 转瞬之间日色已暮，是夜就在山庄泊宿。

en.t: In the blink of an eye the sun had set, and that night he stayed at the mountain villa.
